requirements.statement: A merchant can sign up and create a merchant account

criteria.must: A new user can create a merchant account

requirements.statement: Merchants and Platform Admins sign in via single sign-on

criteria.must: A merchant can sign in via single sign-on and reach their account
A Platform Admin can sign in via single sign-on and reach the admin console

requirements.statement: A merchant can add business details and a bank account to become verified and payout-ready

criteria.must: A merchant can submit business details and a bank account
A merchant cannot accept live payments until their submission is approved

requirements.statement: A merchant can create a payment link/invoice with an amount and description

criteria.must: A merchant can create a payment link specifying an amount and a description

requirements.statement: A merchant can share a payment link with a customer

criteria.must: A created payment link is available as a shareable link a customer can open

requirements.statement: A merchant can view the status and history of their payment links and transactions

criteria.must: A merchant can view a list of their payment links and each one's status
A merchant can view a history of their transactions

requirements.statement: A merchant can view their current balance

criteria.must: A merchant can view their current available balance

requirements.statement: A merchant is notified when a payment is completed

criteria.must: A merchant receives a notification when a customer's payment completes

requirements.statement: A merchant can request a payout to their linked bank account on demand

criteria.must: A merchant can request a payout of their available balance
A requested payout appears in the merchant's payout history with a status

requirements.statement: Payouts also happen automatically on a schedule

criteria.must: The system runs an automatic payout on a daily schedule without a merchant request

requirements.statement: A customer can open a payment link and see the amount and who they are paying

criteria.must: Opening a payment link shows the amount owed and the merchant's name

requirements.statement: A customer can pay using mobile money

criteria.must: A customer can complete payment of a payment link using mobile money

requirements.statement: A customer can pay using a card

criteria.must: A customer can complete payment of a payment link using a card

requirements.statement: A customer receives a receipt after paying

criteria.must: A customer receives a receipt after a successful payment

requirements.statement: A Platform Admin can review merchant onboarding submissions and approve or reject them

criteria.must: A Platform Admin can view a list of pending merchant onboarding submissions
A Platform Admin can approve a pending merchant submission
A Platform Admin can reject a pending merchant submission

requirements.statement: A Platform Admin can view transactions across all merchants

criteria.must: A Platform Admin can view transactions belonging to any merchant, not just one

requirements.statement: A Platform Admin can view and resolve flagged or disputed transactions

criteria.must: A Platform Admin can view a list of disputed transactions
A Platform Admin can resolve a dispute in favor of the merchant
A Platform Admin can resolve a dispute in favor of the customer

requirements.statement: A Platform Admin can suspend or reactivate a merchant account

criteria.must: A Platform Admin can suspend an approved merchant's account
A Platform Admin can reactivate a suspended merchant's account

requirements.statement: A customer pays through a hosted checkout page without creating an account

criteria.must: A customer can complete a payment without signing in or creating an account

requirements.statement: The platform launches supporting Nigeria (NGN), Kenya (KES) and Ghana (GHS), each merchant operating in one home currency

criteria.must: A merchant can register under Nigeria, Kenya, or Ghana with the matching currency

requirements.statement: When a card payment is disputed, the disputed amount is debited from the merchant's balance immediately and reversed if the merchant wins

criteria.must: Raising a dispute on a transaction reduces the merchant's available balance by the disputed amount
Resolving a dispute in the merchant's favor reverses the earlier debit
